architectures.observed_node_note: The development node reports eight H100 80GB HBM3 GPUs and NV18 for every GPU pair. This note is not capability evidence.

qualification_rule: The source-faithful probe, realized geometry, peer access, and local timers must pass before any H100 cell enters ordinary timing.
claim_boundary: H100 is an explicit extension and must not be labeled A100 or GH200.
